name: avatar-picker
summary: 90 code-drawn avatars in flat, ink, crayon, pencil and pixel styles, with a grid or carousel picker.
props: Built-in avatar id, e.g. "flat-01" or "pencil-07". Unknown ids show a neutral placeholder.
Tile shape (rounded follows the kit radius).
Tile colour behind the character; "transparent" for none.
Called with the id and its definition.
Which styles to offer: "flat" | "ink" | "crayon" | "pencil" | "pixel". One style hides the tabs.
Only these ids, in this order.
Shape of the tiles, ring and preview.
One colour for every tile, or one per avatar.
Style tabs: All, Flat, Ink, Crayon, Pencil, Pixel.
Scrolling grid, or one swipeable row (avatarSize defaults to 64 there).
Large preview of the selection with its name, style and id.
Shown when the filters leave nothing.
Selection ring, check badge and tab colour.
Tailwind classes on the root when using NativeWind or Uniwind.
The catalogue ({ id, name, style, background, component }), lookup by id, and the same filter the picker uses.
behavior: Every avatar is react-native-svg paths and rects: no PNGs, URLs or base64, so it works offline and looks the same on iOS, Android and web. Each style has its own 18 characters; ids are stable: flat-01…18, ink-01…18, crayon-01…18, pencil-01…18, pixel-01…18.
The selection ring and check badge spring in, tiles squish while pressed, and the preview pops when the choice changes. Category tabs slide their underline.
layout="grid" fills its width (4 columns on phones, 6 on medium, 8 on expanded screens unless you pass columns) and scrolls inside a bounded parent. layout="carousel" is one swipeable row.
Press squish and the preview pop are skipped; the ring appears instantly.
A selection tick when you pick an avatar or switch tabs. Turn off with haptics={false}.
The grid is a radio group; each tile reads its character's name and selected state. <Avatar> reads as an image labelled with the name.
